events.title: The Quraysh defeat the Muslims at the Battle of Uhud
events.description: Near Mount Uhud, north of Medina, the Quraysh of Mecca under Abu Sufyan defeated the Muslims under Muhammad after archers left their posts. Muhammad was wounded and his uncle Hamza killed, but the Meccans did not follow up their victory.

events.title: Hồ Quý Ly deposes the Trần dynasty and founds the Hồ dynasty
events.description: The minister Hồ Quý Ly overthrew the emperor Thiếu Đế, his own grandson, ending 175 years of Trần rule in Đại Việt and founding the Hồ dynasty. The Ming used his usurpation as a pretext to invade in 1406.
events.html: The minister Hồ Quý Ly overthrew the emperor Thiếu Đế, his own grandson, ending 175 years of Trần rule in Đại Việt and founding the Hồ dynasty. The Ming used his usurpation as a pretext to invade in 1406.

events.title: Waltham Abbey surrenders, the last English monastery to close
events.description: The Augustinian abbey at Waltham in Essex was surrendered to Henry VIII's commissioners. It completed the Dissolution of the Monasteries, which transferred vast church lands to the Crown.
events.html: The Augustinian abbey at Waltham in Essex was surrendered to Henry VIII's commissioners. It completed the Dissolution of the Monasteries, which transferred vast church lands to the Crown.

events.title: Patrick Henry declares 'Give me liberty, or give me death!'
events.description: At the Second Virginia Convention in Richmond, Henry urged the colony to raise a militia against Britain. The convention agreed, and fighting began at Lexington four weeks later.
events.html: At the Second Virginia Convention in Richmond, Henry urged the colony to raise a militia against Britain. The convention agreed, and fighting began at Lexington four weeks later.

events.title: Tsar Paul I murdered in St Michael's Castle
events.description: Conspiring officers killed the erratic Tsar in his bedroom in St Petersburg. His son Alexander I, aware of the plot, succeeded him and later led Russia against Napoleon.
events.html: Conspiring officers killed the erratic Tsar in his bedroom in St Petersburg. His son Alexander I, aware of the plot, succeeded him and later led Russia against Napoleon.

events.title: Mussolini founds the Fasci di Combattimento in Milan
events.description: Benito Mussolini gathered veterans and nationalists in Piazza San Sepolcro to found a new movement. Its blackshirts helped him take power in 1922, and Fascism became a model for Hitler.
events.html: Benito Mussolini gathered veterans and nationalists in Piazza San Sepolcro to found a new movement. Its blackshirts helped him take power in 1922, and Fascism became a model for Hitler.

events.title: Reichstag passes the Enabling Act
events.description: With communists barred and others intimidated, the German parliament allowed Hitler's cabinet to make laws without it. Only the Social Democrats voted against, and the dictatorship had a legal basis.
events.html: With communists barred and others intimidated, the German parliament allowed Hitler's cabinet to make laws without it. Only the Social Democrats voted against, and the dictatorship had a legal basis.

events.title: Gemini 3 makes the first crewed Gemini flight
events.description: Gus Grissom and John Young flew three orbits and became the first astronauts to change their spacecraft's orbit. The Gemini programme prepared the techniques for Apollo.
events.html: Gus Grissom and John Young flew three orbits and became the first astronauts to change their spacecraft's orbit. The Gemini programme prepared the techniques for Apollo.
